title: Not worth the $$$
text: I thought this would be a great surprise for my kids to look forward to every month. They definitely love the idea of getting a box full of toys. However, this is not worth the cost. It almost seems like a $10 party city box that you’d hand out at a kid’s birthday party (like a goody bag). It’s most definitely filled with cheap trinkets and nothing of substance. Really wanted to like this and it was an epic fail.
label: negative
